exposure.needed: whether cert-manager is installed and upgraded through an OperatorHub/OLM package (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub or operatorhub.io) rather than Helm or static manifests

assertion.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages; v1.16.5 is the last cert-manager release on OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io), and the cert-manager-olm repository is archived.

proposal.undeterminedReason: consequence: The evidence says only that v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub. It does not say what happens to OperatorHub-based installs, such as whether a move to another install method is required, so no consequence kind can be stated from it.
